exercises.prompt: I would rather have tea than coffee.
exercises.why: A sentence involving such a clause states that an event will take place if the condition is fulfilled. Being statements of direct fact, they are expressed by the indicative mood. The future condition is expressed in English by the present tense, whereas in Russian it is expressed by the future. In sentences of this type the conditions postulated by the «если бы» clause are either improbable or downright contrary to existing fact. *Если бы я был здоров, я пошёл бы в школу.* — 1) If I were well, I would go to school tomorrow. 2) If I had been well, I would have gone to school yesterday. The English language uses special forms of the verb for each of these two types of supposition, whereas the… — DLI, Lessons 90 and 91.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: A sentence involving such a clause states that an event will take place if the condition is fulfilled. (DLI, Lessons 90 and 91)
